observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor stage performance at a festival, with a large seated audience and a decorated backdrop.
observation.dancers: A large group of young men and a few young boys, shirtless and bare-chested with necklaces and purple and white waist wraps.
observation.formation_and_space: A wide horizontal line across the stage, transitioning between seated, kneeling, and standing positions.
observation.posture: Upright when standing, but mostly performing seated or kneeling with straight backs and engaged torsos.
observation.footwork: Seated leg positions with crossed ankles or extended legs; standing feet apart with weight shifts on beats; footwork details partially occluded while seated.
observation.arms_and_hands: Energetic hand clapping, precise arm extensions, and slaps against the chest, thighs, and arms synchronized to the rhythm.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torsos lean back or twist while seated; occasional chest slaps and forward bows.
observation.partnering: None; group choreography with independent unison movement.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Transitions between sitting cross-legged on the floor, kneeling on one or both knees, and standing upright.
observation.costume_and_props: Matching purple and white fabric wraps around the waist, white shell or seed necklaces; some wear headbands; no handheld props.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork details for seated members are occluded by their placement and low camera angles.

signature_moments.what: Dancers lean back onto their elbows while seated and clap in unison to the beat.
Small boy dances through the seated line while performers clap and shout.
Dancers rise to kneeling positions with arms outstretched and clapping.
